items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Roy Zimmerman used to call him pokechops... [INTERVIEWEE] Hmm. And I've never known why either.

ctx.x: A lot of people did that?

A lot of people did. Roy Zimmerman used to call him pokechops. That was plural, pokechops. Pokechops. Pokechops. As I remember, pokechops. Or pokechops. Maybe it was pokechops. I don't know. Sam Decker Mill called me pokechops.
Hmm. And I've never known why either. It's something I never thought about.

items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: That was in the last days of the band. Pete left right after we went out there. Roy Zimmerman left right after we went out there.

ctx.x: That's about 4 by 6 inches or something like that.

Then we went out to the Airline Highway at a club, Club Basin Street. How long back? We did. Very short-lived. That was in the last days of the band. Pete left right after we went out there. Roy Zimmerman left right after we went out there. They were replaced by Fano Rupolo on clarinet, and Bobby Brockman on piano. And we played primarily for dancing and some jazz. They were trying to get back to the Lenfence days, when they were primarily a dance band with a couple of Dixieland tunes and a couple of show tunes.…
You really had to know... You know, it seems very simple sitting on the Asta at a roncel and all you gotta do is buy some liquor and some paper. Seems like it, huh? Yeah. Yeah, that's what you think.
